about: The humanization lanes whose Pangram predictions tools/humanization/pangram_ledger.py scores (2026-10-20). Each lane: its ledger (one append-only file, written by the tool from the first prediction on) and its records from before the ledger, read as they are. A new lane adds itself here with its ledger path; an older format needs a legacy reader in the tool.

lanes.why_no_page: articles/inner-child-therapy/PARALLEL-WRITE-LOCK.json is active, so only that lane's writer adds files there; its numbers are on the universal page, read from its table
